bullets.title: RCL: Multi-broker consensus Buy on $3B Sandals acquisition; stock at 52-week low creates entry
bullets.body: RCL acquiring 50% stake in Sandals/Beaches Resorts for $3B (~10x forward EBITDA on $600M run-rate), expected to close early 2027 and be EPS-accretive. UBS maintains Buy ($367 PT), JPM upgrades to Outperform, Mizuho upgrades to Outperform — all noting only ~0.2-0.3x incremental leverage, 30% guest overlap, and TAM expansion into $35B global all-inclusive market. Key risk per MS: cannibalization of cruise demand rather than pure synergy. Stock hit a 52-week low (-32.3% YTD, -5.1% on the day) despite broadly constructive deal math.

bullets.title: NVDA: CEO defends AI safety as compute tailwind; Vera Rubin NVL72 racks now shipping via SMCI
bullets.body: Jensen Huang argued AI safety requires more compute investment (80% of effort vs. historical 20%), not slower development, and that agents expand TAM ~1000x. Separately, Supermicro began shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 racks with full liquid-cooling supporting up to gigawatt-scale deployments (1,152 GPUs, 331 TB HBM4 per unit).

bullets.title: META Muse: 250K DAUs in week one; ecosystem winners and risks assessed across multiple desks
bullets.body: META Muse reached 250K DAUs / 500K total users in its first week with partners including SHOP, EXPE, CART, BKNG, LYV; META Connect keynote tonight (7pm ET) expected to announce further partnerships. MS and Pivotal both bullish on META as agentic commerce winner; Amazon blocked Muse from its site two weeks after launch. Broader debate: Pivotal views widespread agent use as negative for digital advertising broadly; MS estimates $30T of consumer spend addressable through agentic offerings.

bullets.title: MU: Wolfe and UBS both raise estimates; supply-demand gap widening into C2027
bullets.body: Wolfe sees upward bias to memory pricing with DRAM/HBM mix stronger; MU estimates unchanged but notes potential 25-50% buyback of market cap in CY26-27 as Chips Act buyback restrictions expire in December. UBS's Tim Arcuri raises MU C2027/28/29E EPS to $212/$277/$219, well above Street; supply-demand gap widening into C2027 with equipment shortages in DRAM, MLCC, PCB boards. MU stock has fallen below its own EPS estimate trend; November quarter revenue guide is key catalyst.

bullets.title: CRWV: UBS initiates Buy at $120 PT; stock trades at 3x 2027E revenue
bullets.body: UBS analyst Karl Keirstead initiates CoreWeave with a Buy rating and $120 price target, noting the stock already reflects key risks at 3x 2027E revenue. Channel checks highlight CoreWeave's strong reputation for reliability and performance vs. competitors as a key differentiator.

bullets.title: HUT/WULF/CORZ: UBS initiates all three AI colocation names at Buy on power constraint thesis
bullets.body: UBS analyst Ryan Gravett initiates HUT ($143 PT), WULF ($24 PT), and CORZ ($24 PT) all at Buy, arguing power constraints are the critical bottleneck as AI datacenter demand has exploded. The thesis is that owned power capacity creates structural advantage vs. hyperscalers.

bullets.title: DELL: COO meeting validates structural AI TAM through 2030; memory scarcity may extend 5+ years
bullets.body: MS sales desk reports DELL COO meeting reinforced bullish view: inference token growth expected 87x by 2030, driving persistent on-prem + hybrid cloud demand vs. historical hardware cycles. Memory supply scarcity may last 5+ years (vs. historical 2-4 quarters), with agentic workloads requiring KV cache and persistent agent data — making storage an underappreciated beneficiary.

bullets.title: MSFT: Copilot Super App launching October with 30-50% seat discounts + usage-based pricing
bullets.body: MS TMT desk reports Microsoft is launching a Copilot Super App in October featuring 30-50% seat discounts combined with usage-based pricing, a notable commercial shift. Separately, MSFT will consider shareholder ESG proposals at annual meetings through 2027 despite proposed SEC rule changes.

bullets.title: SHOP: Agentic commerce catalyst; Muse partner + Piper expert call scheduled 10/2
bullets.body: Shopify is a named META Muse partner driving agentic commerce. MS identifies SHOP as a TAM winner via agentic storefronts, catalog integration, and payments gateway. Piper Sandler scheduling a 10/2 expert call with a top Shopify Partner to discuss direct catalog, UCP protocol, and merchant KPI implications.

bullets.title: COHR/LITE/CIEN: MS post-ECOC sees NPO trials in 2028; prefers KEYS, LITE, COHR; supply tight 12-18mo
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's ECOC first-take sees NPO (coherent optical with pluggables) trials beginning 2028, driven by Open CPX MSA creating an ecosystem beyond NVDA's closed solution. InP substrate remains primary bottleneck for 12-18 months. LITE supplies bulk of Google OCS value; COHR positioned across CPO/NPO portfolio; KEYS benefits regardless of implementation path. Wolfe ECOC debrief call scheduled 9/24.

bullets.title: MRVL: Jefferies maintains Buy, $325 PT; non-deal roadshow Oct 7 NYC
bullets.body: Jefferies analyst Blayne Curtis reiterates Buy on Marvell with a $325 price target. CEO Matt Murphy, CFO Dan Durn, and IR will hold investor meetings in New York on October 7.

bullets.title: DIS: Disney+ raises monthly price 13% to $21.49 effective today
bullets.body: Disney raised its Disney+ monthly subscription price by 13% to $21.49/month, with user notifications going out Wednesday. Stock was trading at $104.42, up $0.60 on the announcement.

bullets.title: FSLR: DOC anti-stockpiling rule reinforces pricing power; analyst OW, $323 PT
bullets.body: MS Energy desk notes the DOC anti-stockpiling rule reinforces First Solar's ability to push price increases and improves the profitability outlook for 2029+. Analyst maintains Overweight at $323 PT; first indications of new bookings and pricing trends expected at 3Q earnings.

bullets.title: AMD: 52-week high with +286% YTD; semi group still ~15% below ATHs despite 5-day 13.5% rally
bullets.body: GS TMT notes the semiconductor group (SOX) rallied ~13.5% over 5 sessions led by ALAB +44%, ARM +39%, CRDO +28%, AMD/INTC +25%, but the group remains ~15% below ATHs. AMD hit a 52-week high. The rally is being characterized as narrow and 'size'-driven; only ~30% of S&P 500 constituents are above their 50-dma despite the index near ATHs.

bullets.title: HOOD: Hedgeye initiating deep dive with slight long bias; cycle-trading framework emphasized
bullets.body: Hedgeye hosting a HOOD-focused call noting the stock's diversification into crypto, options, retirement, prediction markets, and tokenization — event contracts drove nearly half of this year's revenue growth. ~50% of revenue remains high-margin 'degenerate trading.' Starting with slight long bias but framing as a cyclical trade, not a secular platform call, given current multiple assumes good times continue.

bullets.title: PSKY/WBD: Musk equity syndicate consideration; antitrust settlement requires 30+ films/yr with strict penalties
bullets.body: Paramount Skydance is weighing asking Elon Musk and other wealthy individuals to join an equity investment syndicate. Separately, the state AG antitrust settlement for the PSKY-WBD merger mandates 30 films/year (rising to 32 in years 3-5), $1.5B incremental U.S. production spend, a $5M/year independent film fund, $47.5M workforce fund, and an independent monitor — with Miramax divestiture and $30M per-film penalties for misses.

bullets.title: DKNG: Fanatics capturing ~8% OSB share; JPM hosting prediction market regulatory update
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's Fanatics primer (private, $31B valuation) highlights DKNG as a public comp trading at double-digit EV/Sales vs Fanatics' 2.2-2.5x. Fanatics has taken 500+bps OSB GGR share since late 2023 and launched prediction markets in 24 states including CA/TX/FL. JPM separately hosting a prediction market regulatory update call with gaming law attorney Daniel Wallach.

bullets.title: AFRM: B Riley sees open-loop card adoption as next monetization catalyst
bullets.body: B Riley notes Affirm and peers (SEZL, KLARQ) are showing strong open-loop Visa/Mastercard BNPL card adoption, with monetization model shifting from merchant fees toward interchange, interest payments, and subscription/per-transaction fees. Physical open-loop cards also in development.

bullets.title: CRM/HUBS: JPM hosting pre-quiet period software sector call with Dreamforce/UNBOUND channel checks
bullets.body: JPM holding a software sector update call today covering large- and mid-cap software, with specific channel feedback from Salesforce Dreamforce and HubSpot UNBOUND conferences. Sector valuation and opportunity analysis included.

bullets.title: NET: 52-week high (+57.6% YTD); Citi prefers over FSLY for security exposure
bullets.body: Cloudflare hit a 52-week high on 9/23 with +57.6% YTD gains, with GS noting it is in a strong 'inference economy' trend channel. Citi's Fatima Boolani stays Neutral on Fastly despite 40%+ Security growth, explicitly preferring NET as growing 2-2.5x faster for similar exposure.
